title: Not the Norm | KEY.co
description_expanded: With panoramic views of the Gulf and direct access to sugar-white sands, Not the Norm lives up to its name with effortless style and unforgettable amenities. This 11-bedroom, nine-and-a-half-bathroom estate is designed to impress, featuring a beachfront pool with a spa tub, private beach access, and room to park 14 vehicles. Inside, you'll find a grand open-concept living space, a fully equipped chef’s kitchen, and a dedicated game room, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The full-floor master suite offers a private balcony and spa-like ensuite—an elevated retreat with stunning ocean views. Ideal for large family gatherings, corporate retreats, or upscale escapes, the home includes a separate guest house with its own living area, kitchenette, and multiple private bedrooms. Four complimentary bikes and in-season beach chair service make coastal adventures easy, while the in-home elevator adds a layer of comfort and convenience. From the elegant design touches to the outdoor lounge with grill and in-pool dining table, every detail invites connection, indulgence, and relaxation—because your next getaway shouldn’t be ordinary. It should be extraordinary.
